stem: 在通过组织的全企业制裁风险评估发现可能存在漏洞,即与业务规模和运营情况相比,生成的制裁筛查警报数量过少时,以下哪项行动最能确保该风险领域得到妥善管理和尽可能彻底的整改？

options.A: 审查企业范围的风险评估方法
options.B: 加强员工关于已关闭警报的合理化说明文档编制方面的培训
options.C: 重新审视交易后监控系统的参数和阈值
options.D: 审查筛选系统当前采用的模糊逻辑

stem_en: Upon learning of a potential weakness through an organization's enterprise-wide sanctions risk assessment relating to a low number of sanctions screening alerts generated compared to the business size and operations identified, which action would best ensure the risk area is properly managed and remediated to the best possible extent?

options_en.A: Reviewing the enterprise-wide risk assessment methodology
options_en.B: Enhancing staff training on the documentation of justification on closed alerts
options_en.C: Revisiting the post-transaction monitoring system parameters and thresholds
options_en.D: Reviewing the fuzzy logic currently used by the screening system
